title: Rump steak with roast vegetables and herb quark
steps: Preheat the oven to 220 °C. Cut the potatoes, courgette, pepper and onion into chunks, toss with 2 tsp oil, thyme and salt and roast for 25 minutes.
Stir the quark with chopped herbs, crushed garlic, salt and pepper.
Pat the steaks dry, season and sear in the remaining oil in a very hot pan for 2–4 minutes per side.
Rest for 5 minutes, slice and serve with the vegetables and herb quark.
